rules.name: ink-text-policy
rules.summary: Text and UI ink is #585858 on white; saturated colour arrives only through sanctioned surfaces (hover/focus states, tile pastels, menu ground).
rules.why: The template's monochrome reading surface is its design identity; colour-as-surface keeps contrast safe (pink #ff6bbc on white ≈ 2.1:1).
rules.fix: Return text colours to ink; move accent ambitions into hover/focus/surface roles or the pink-accent candidate.

rules.name: radius-family
rules.summary: Corners are 4px across buttons, fields, boxes, images and tiles (circles only for logo/icon discs).
rules.why: One radius family ties the system together; the deployment flattened everything to 0px.
rules.fix: Restore border-radius: 4px on affected components (or re-open the radius decision as a candidate).

rules.name: tracked-caps-display
rules.summary: Display labels (h2-h4, buttons, table heads) are uppercase 900 with 0.35em letter-spacing; h1 stays sentence case 700.
rules.why: Observed across type, buttons and heads; the tracking is the system's typographic signature.
rules.fix: Apply uppercase/900/0.35em to display labels; never apply caps-tracking to running text.

rules.name: flat-inset-rings
rules.summary: Depth is drawn with inset rings (`inset 0 0 0 Npx`) and rules — never blurred or elevated shadows.
rules.why: No blurred shadow exists in the template; borders-as-shadows keep the flat surface honest.
rules.fix: Replace drop shadows with inset rings or 1px rules.

rules.name: underline-fields
rules.summary: Fields are underline-only: tint ground, 1px #c9c9c9 bottom line, pink underline on focus.
rules.why: The form language is minimal by design; boxes around fields would break the page rhythm.
rules.fix: Strip field box borders; keep the bottom line + focus underline.
